items.title: Broader indices underperform; midcaps fall, smallcaps flat on profit booking
items.description: The near-term trend of Nifty remains positive amidst broader range movement. Having failed to surpass the crucial overhead resistance of 24200, one may expect further consolidation or minor dip by next week.

items.title: When oil prices fall and geopolitical risks recede: The sectors that truly win in India
items.description: Selective exposure to aviation, OMCs, paints, tyres, automobiles, logistics, and rate-sensitive financials offers a high-conviction way to participate in India’s ongoing structural growth story.
